about.title: About us
about.lead: International B2B trading in food, feed, and agricultural commodities — reliable supply and transparent terms.
about.body: FAFCO is an international B2B trading company focused on the supply of food products, feed materials, and agricultural commodities. We are built on hands-on experience in agriculture, logistics, and international trade. We understand the full supply chain — from production and storage to transportation and final delivery. Our goal is to provide reliable supply, transparent terms, and long-term partnerships. We work with partners across Canada, Europe, and Eastern Europe, offering flexible solutions tailored to each client's needs.
about.missionBody: We focus on transparent terms, disciplined execution, and long-term relationships — not one-off transactions.
whyBullets: Clear communication on specifications and documentation
Flexible volumes aligned to commercial reality

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: FAFCO (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and disclose personal information when you use fafco.ca (the “Site”) and request a quote, in line with applicable Canadian privacy law including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) where it applies.
privacy.contactBody: For questions about this policy or your personal information, contact us at the email address shown on our website.
privacy.collectBody: We may collect contact details you provide (name, company, email, phone), message content, and details of products or volumes you request. We also collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited, through our hosting and analytics providers.
privacy.useBody: We use this information to respond to quote requests, operate and improve the Site, communicate with you, comply with law, and protect our legitimate business interests.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers (e.g. email delivery, hosting) who assist us under contract, and when required by law.
privacy.retentionBody: We retain information as long as needed for the purposes above and as required by law.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on applicable law, you may request access to or correction of your personal information. We will respond within a reasonable time.
privacy.intlBody: If data is processed outside Canada, we take steps appropriate to the risk, including contractual safeguards where applicable.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy. The “Last updated” date will change when we do.
